launches.title: CloudCruise - Build healthcare browser automations faster
launches.tagline: Run self-healing payer portal and EHR workflows on fully managed infrastructure
launches.body:
Last month, we served 500,000+ browser automations for some of the fastest growing healthcare companies in the US. CloudCruise is now GA.

**The problem with browser agents today**\
Building browser agents with current frameworks seems promising until you hit production. The observation-action loop - where LLMs observe, reason, and act at runtime - is slow, expensive, and hard to debug.

**How CloudCruise works differently**\
CloudCruise solves this by generating deterministic automation workflows instead. Our platform uses two specialized agents: a Builder Agent that converts your business process description into a deterministic browser automation workflow, and a Maintenance Agent that fixes broken workflows once they’re in production.

The Builder Agent takes your workflow description (or an existing SOP) and generates an automation workflow. You watch it work in real-time and clarify edge cases. Credentials are stored securely in your vault.

The Maintenance Agent keeps scripts alive in production. When a payer portal changes its selectors, adds a popup, or goes down, the Maintenance Agent detects it, classifies the error, and fixes it automatically. Complex issues escalate to a human.

**Why this architecture wins**\
LLM costs are amortized over thousands of runs instead of paid on every step. Once in production, workflows are versionable, behave consistently and run at browser-native speed.

**Try It**\
If you're building in healthcare, sign up at [app.cloudcruise.com](http://app.cloudcruise.com) and try us out. We're live with dozens of teams doing eligibility verification, prior auth, payment posting and more.

launches.title: CloudCruise - Automation that works like humans do
launches.tagline: Automate repetitive work in your browser like generating leads, filling out forms or processing orders.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79207&key=user_uploads/682099/1d9ebede-6872-499f-835d-bb6ef6249f42)

**😡 CloudCruise was created to solve our own problem!**

While working on our previous idea, we spent 20 hours each week checking the websites of hundreds of companies to see if they met our target criteria.

We wanted to automate this process, but we couldn’t find any good options. APIs were too limited and none of the web automation tools worked.

It turned out that other founders were also looking for solutions to this problem. More generally, knowledge workers are spending hours doing repetitive tasks, which can’t be automated with current tools. We found HR teams filling out admin forms, Operations processing orders, and Sales manually prospecting. 

**☁️ CloudCruise automates repetitive work in the browser**

[CloudCruise](https://cloudcruise.com/) processes a list of items with a step-by-step workflow. You can use our tool to grab any list on the web, or you can upload a CSV. 

Workflows are made up of a series of actions like inputting text, clicking elements, or extracting data from a page. 

Each step can be LLM-powered, so CloudCruise can translate general instructions like “find contact page” to a click action and DOM element on any website. This works even if the website layout is unpredictable or DOM elements are rotated.

CloudCruise works right next to you, in a tab of your browser. So you can either watch its progress or continue with other work as normal. 

**🧑‍🤝🧑 The Team**

Co-founders [Adrian](https://linkedin.com/in/adrian-ziegler), [Felix](https://linkedin.com/in/felix-eckert-807095191) & [Vere](https://linkedin.com/in/felix-eckert-807095191) bonded at Stanford and Google. Previously, Adrian was building state-of-the-art computer vision models, Felix was researching new user interfaces for LLMs, and Vere was shipping billion-dollar products at YouTube Ads.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79207&key=user_uploads/682099/0bd2996e-34ef-4b3b-a16b-01291c5dc048)

* If you have a repetitive workflow you’d like to automate, join the [waitlist](https://cloudcruise.com/). We’re onboarding new users to the product every day. 
* We just launched a free Chrome extension that lets you grab & download a list from anywhere on the web. Check it out [here](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/cloudcruise/idegaiedponalbmkcpmmeimfjpfkhopn)!
